# Bridge The Gap Educational Services

Bridge The Gap Educational Services is an education support and professional development provider under RushedTech Educational Services.

## Core services
- Tutoring Services: Academic tutoring across CAPS and IB curricula (individual and group intervention models).
- Matric Support Services: Matric rewrites, matric tutoring, subject additions, and SBA portfolio support.
- Teacher Professional Development: Workshops, training, coaching, and development programmes for education professionals.
- Coaching Services: Coaching for learners, school leaders, and educators.

## Target audiences
- School leaders
- Parents and guardians
- Learners
- Teachers and education professionals

## Location and delivery
- Base location: Kempton Park, Birchleigh North, Gauteng, South Africa
- Delivery: Online, in-person, and group interventions
